dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: May 27**

A dominant day in the books as several players etched their names into the record books. In the Toronto Blue Jays' 2-1 win over the Miami Marlins, Kazuma Okamoto homered for the 11th time this season, going yard on a fly ball to right center field. On the mound, Eury Pérez threw 4 shutout innings, striking out 9 and walking none.

In the Seattle Mariners' 9-1 thrashing of the Athletics, Rob Refsnyder went deep for the first time this year, driving in 3 runs on a solo shot. Logan Gilbert pitched 6 strong innings, fanning 6 and walking 2.

The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Padres 3-0, with Trea Turner hitting his 7th homer of the season. Cristopher Sánchez threw 7 scoreless innings, striking out 9 and walking none.

In the Baltimore Orioles' 11-2 blowout of the Tampa Bay Rays, Blaze Alexander hit 3 home runs, driving in 6 runs. Connelly Early pitched 7 shutout innings for the Red Sox in their 8-0 win over the Atlanta Braves, striking out 7 and walking 3.

Gerrit Cole dominated on the mound for the Yankees, throwing 6.2 scoreless innings in a 7-0 win over the Kansas City Royals. Yordan Alvarez hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 for the Houston Astros in their 4-3 win over the Texas Rangers.
